title: Fleet Data Segment
applicability: Included in all fleet card transaction requests; appears in Data Section 3.
scopeNote: Core-structure baseline: Segment Type/Length and mutual-exclusion/trigger rules only. Not field-by-field exhaustive.

businessRequirements.title: Segment Type field in the Fleet Data Segment has fixed value 101.
Segment Length identifies the Fleet Data Segment's total length including Segment Type and Field Separators.
The Fleet Data Segment has a maximum length of 61 alphanumeric characters.
Segment 101 (Fleet Data Segment) and Segment 145 (Enhanced Fleet Segment) must not be sent together.

testCases.positive: Segment Length matches actual serialized length and stays within 61 characters
Only one of Segment 101 or 145 present
negative: Both Segment 101 and 145 present in the same request

testDataStatus: Segment Type/Length structural checks are synthesizable; the 101/145 mutual-exclusion rule needs AI-generated negative artifacts.
remaining: Author full field-by-field Fleet Data Segment coverage (Odometer, Vehicle Number, Job Number, etc.) beyond this core-structure baseline.
